_comment: Layout of the full-screen combat HUD frame. Every number is in design pixels on a 1280x800 canvas;
the frame image (art/ui_frame.png, optional) is stretched to that canvas, so its pixel size does not matter.
bands: how far the frame reaches in from each screen edge. The rest is the viewport the world shows through.
frame.slice: where the art is cut into nine pieces. Corner blocks keep their size; the strips between them stretch.
zones: [x, y, w, h] on the design canvas. The anchor names the screen edge a zone keeps its distance from
when the window is not exactly 16:10 (center = stays centered, right/bottom = moves with that edge).
Keep (1280 - min_width) / 2 design px of clearance between a center zone and its left/right neighbours:
narrowing the window moves right-anchored zones twice as far as centered ones.
